headline: Mitsotakis' letter to Ursula von der Leyen on energy costs - The measures Greece asks the EU to adopt
summary: Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis wrote to European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen asking that member states' energy cost measures be excluded from fiscal budgets. He seeks greater fiscal flexibility.
why: Fiscal rules set how much member states can spend, and EU decisions on budget flexibility affect government borrowing and energy support across the bloc.
